neighbours.label: the full stop after a one-word attention-grabbing vocative or interjection (Dude. / Y'all. / Bro.) that opens an emphatic informal outburst, as against full stops that end ordinary sentences in the same chatty text
fire: We finally got the keys to the new apartment and Bro. This kitchen is enormous!
My sister texted me after the game: "Y’all. We actually won that thing!"
He saw the parking ticket on his windshield and just said, "Dude. Seriously?"
I opened the box from grandma last night and Guys. She knitted me a whole blanket!
Okay so the season finale aired yesterday and Y’all. I cannot stop crying.
My friend tasted the hot sauce and yelled, "Bro. My mouth is on fire!"
The waiter brought out the dessert tower and Dude. It was taller than my kid.
Coach looked at our scoreboard and said, "Ladies. That was unbelievable!"
quiet: We finally got the keys to the new apartment today. The kitchen is quite large.
My sister texted me after the game to say we won. The score was close.
He saw the parking ticket on his windshield and sighed. It cost forty dollars.
I opened the box from grandma last night. She knitted me a warm blanket.
The season finale aired yesterday evening. I watched it with my parents.
My friend tasted the hot sauce at dinner. He thought it was rather spicy.
The waiter brought out the dessert after the meal. It was a lemon tart.
Coach looked at our scoreboard after practice. He wrote the results down.
